Info

Implementation of IMacroExpander adjusting 4th-axis tool orientation to follow path tangent.

class scaralang.core.service.compiler.macro.tangent_macro_expander.TangentMacroExpander[source]¶

Bases: object

Macro expander computing tangential orientation for the 4th wrist roll axis along path.

It defines:

attributes:
None.
methods:
can_expand - Checks if instruction requires tangential Phi or orientation.
expand - Updates tool orientation mode and heading in compiler context.
calculate_tangent_angle - Computes tangent heading angle between two 2D points.
classmethod calculate_tangent_angle(*, source: Point2D, target: Point2D, fallback_phi: float) → float[source]¶

Computes tangent heading angle in degrees between two 2D points.

Parameters:

  • source – Source 2D point coordinates.

  • target – Destination 2D point coordinates.

  • fallback_phi – Heading to return if travel distance is zero.

Returns:

Heading angle in degrees [-180, +180].

can_expand(*, instruction: ScaraInstruction) → bool[source]¶

Checks whether this expander handles TOOL_ORIENT instructions.

Parameters:

instruction – ScaraInstruction node to check.

Returns:

True if TOOL_ORIENT, False otherwise.

expand(*, instruction: ScaraInstruction, context: ScaraCompilerContext) → tuple[ScaraInstruction, ...][source]¶

Configures tool orientation mode in compiler context.

Parameters:

  • instruction – TOOL_ORIENT instruction node.

  • context – Active compiler context.

Returns:

Empty tuple since orientation configuration mutates context only.
